summary: גָּחוֹן names the belly on which the serpent moves in Genesis 3:14. Leviticus 11:42 also uses the word for the underside on which a creature crawls.

senses.definition: The part of an animal’s body that rests against the ground as it crawls.

evidence.note: The serpent is told that it will go on its גָּחוֹן.
Going on the belly distinguishes one manner of movement from walking on four feet or having many feet.
